task_description: Implement Phase 5: Auth and Sessions for the Doot DSL compiler. This phase adds: HMAC cookie signing, argon2 password hashing, built-in signup/login/logout routes, session middleware that populates ctx.currentUser, default-deny auth enforcement, role-based access control, email verification stubs, and auth schema DDL generation.

verification.summary: All 596 tests pass via nimble test (84 new auth tests + 512 existing across 10 test files). Full E2E server tests exercise complete auth flow. Code review v1 found 5 issues (including critical role self-assignment vulnerability). All 5 fixed. Code review v2 APPROVED with 3 non-blocking notes for future improvement.
